Account must be opened IN PERSON at a participating branch — online accounts do not qualify; the promotional offer must be activated by the banker at account opening.
Only Pinnacle, Embark, and Foundation checking accounts are eligible.
Existing customers with a checking account, or anyone who had a deposit account in the last 12 months, do not qualify.
Account must be funded within 10 days of account opening to qualify.
Must enroll in online banking within 90 calendar days of account opening.
Bonus paid within 45 calendar days after all requirements are met; account must be open without a negative balance to receive it.
Bonus reported as interest earned on IRS Form 1099-INT — taxable.
Limit one $250 bonus per qualifying account; one per household per address; fiduciary accounts and nonprofits do not qualify; employees of Columbia Bank and affiliates not eligible.
Cannot be combined with any other checking account offers; offer may be changed or restricted at any time.
